table.retrieve:
SELECT
	DSTBIDLEN=9, 
	DSTBID=:as_distcode + REPLICATE(' ', 6 - LEN(:as_distcode)),
	CLDATELEN=10,
	CLDATE=Convert(varchar(10), :ar_enddate, 103),
	PRDIDLEN=9,
	PRDID=SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(I.CustomICode)), 1, 9) + REPLICATE(' ', 10 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(I.CustomICode, 1, 9))))),
	PRDLEN=50,
	PRD = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(I.NAME, 1, 50))) + REPLICATE(' ', 50 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(I.NAME, 1, 50))))),
	BatchNoLEN=10,
	BatchNo=ISNULL(ST.Batch, '.'),
	ExpiryLEN=10,
	Expiry=Convert(varchar(10), ST.Expiry, 103),
	CLBalanceLEN=14,
	CLBalance=STR(SUM( 
		CASE WHEN TYPE = 'OP' OR TYPE = 'PV' OR TYPE = 'SR' OR TYPE = 'RV' OR TYPE = 'AI' THEN +1 
		ELSE -1 END * (ST.qty + ST.bonus)), 14),
	InTransitLEN=14,
	InTransit=STR(SUM(ISNULL(I.TransitStock, 0)), 14),
	ShortageLEN=14,
	Shortage=STR(0, 14),
	ExpiredLEN=14,
	Expired=STR(0, 14),
	OpeningLen =14,
	Opening	= STR(SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END), 14),
	PurchaseLen =14,
	Purchase = STR(SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'PV' THEN +1 WHEN TYPE = 'PR' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END * (qty + bonus)), 14),
	OtherInLen =12,
	OtherIn = STR(SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'RV' OR TYPE = 'AI' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END), 12),
	SalesLen =14,
	Sales = STR(SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'SV' THEN Qty ELSE 0 END), 14),
	BonusLen =14,
	Bonus = STR(SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'SV' THEN Bonus ELSE 0 END), 14),
	ReturnsLen =14,
	Returns = STR(SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'SR' THEN Qty ELSE 0 END), 14),
	OtherOutLen =14,
	OtherOut = STR(SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'IV' OR TYPE = 'AD' OR TYPE = 'DS' THEN qty + bonus ELSE 0 END), 14),
	ClosingUnitsLen =14,
	ClosingUnits = STR(SUM( 
		CASE WHEN TYPE = 'OP' OR TYPE = 'PV' OR TYPE = 'SR' OR TYPE = 'RV' OR TYPE = 'AI' THEN +1 
		ELSE -1 END * (qty + bonus)), 14)
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, batch, expiry, qty = sum(qty), bonus = 0
	FROM	
		(select	pd.icode,
			batch = pd.batch, pd.expiry, 
			qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry 
		UNION ALL
		select 	pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry, 
			qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry
		UNION ALL
		select	 sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
			qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			  sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
		UNION ALL
		select 	sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
			qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			  sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
		UNION ALL
		select	 sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
			qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
		UNION ALL
		select	 sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
			qty  = sum(sd.qty)
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
		UNION ALL
		select	 sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
		UNION ALL
		select	 sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
			qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
		UNION ALL
		select	 d.icode, d.batch, d.expiry, 
			qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
		      h.duesatisfydate < :ar_startdate AND
			d.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
		Group By d.icode, d.batch, d.expiry) A
	GROUP BY icode, batch, expiry
	UNION ALL
	select 	type='PV',
		pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry, 
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits
			when 2 THEN pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits
			else pd.bonusqty
			end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select 	type='PR',
		pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry, 
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(pd.bonusqty)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
	      pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		pd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By pd.icode, pd.batch, pd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select 	type='SV',
		sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode, sd.batch,  sd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select 	type='SR',
		sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select 	type='IV',
		sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select 	type='DS',
		d.icode, d.batch, d.expiry, 
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate >= :ar_startdate and h.duesatisfydate <= :ar_enddate AND
		d.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By d.icode, d.batch, d.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select 	type='RV',
		sd.icode,sd.batch, sd.expiry, 
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode, sd.batch,  sd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select type='AI', sd.icode, sd.batch,  sd.expiry, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = 0
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD', sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus = 0
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate AND
		sd.icode=i.icode and i.manfcode in (:manfcode)
	Group By sd.icode, sd.batch, sd.expiry) St, 
	Item i
WHERE st.icode = i.icode
GROUP BY i.name, i.customicode, st.batch, st.expiry
HAVING SUM(ST.Qty) <> 0
ORDER BY i.customicode, st.batch, st.expiry
